approval.scope: Phase 2 canonical Evo2 pilot, Phase 4 cache miss/hit validation, and Phase 5 smoke-test evidence only

candidate_statuses.preprocessing: ACGT; exact GRCh38 8192-bp context; forward and reverse-complement raw score
candidate_statuses.embeddings: supported by source-level contract; remote embedding smoke not run
candidate_statuses.fine_tuning: official paths documented; not authorized or run

candidate_statuses.raw_score_semantics: masked-LM logits; no official raw REF-vs-ALT allele-likelihood contract
candidate_statuses.ref_vs_alt: synthetic one-base pair produced a finite pooled embedding delta; not a GRCh38 variant score
candidate_statuses.embeddings: real H100 smoke PASS; final hidden shape [2,47,1024]
candidate_statuses.fine_tuning: downstream fine-tuning documented; not authorized or run
candidate_statuses.inclusion_blocker: No frozen GRCh38 parity or predeclared pseudo-likelihood score transform; remains excluded from Phase 6 raw-score benchmark.

candidate_statuses.preprocessing: official character tokenizer; 131072-bp model context; RC augmentation model
candidate_statuses.raw_score_semantics: masked-LM logits; no official raw REF-vs-ALT allele-likelihood contract
candidate_statuses.ref_vs_alt: synthetic one-base pair produced a finite pooled embedding delta; custom forward accepts input_ids without attention_mask
candidate_statuses.embeddings: real H100 smoke PASS; final hidden shape [2,257,256]
candidate_statuses.fine_tuning: official downstream/RC procedure documented; not authorized or run
candidate_statuses.inclusion_blocker: No frozen GRCh38 raw-SNV score protocol; remains excluded from Phase 6 raw-score benchmark.

candidate_statuses.raw_score_semantics: official GPN-Star forward/reverse averaged alternate-minus-reference LLR
candidate_statuses.ref_vs_alt: compatible in principle, but exact alignment asset is absent
candidate_statuses.embeddings: official package advertises embedding path; not run
candidate_statuses.fine_tuning: official recipes documented; not authorized or run
candidate_statuses.blocker: Required matching alignment archive is approximately 42 GB compressed and outside the bounded approval.

candidate_statuses.raw_score_semantics: CADD deleteriousness score, not sequence-model allele LLR
candidate_statuses.ref_vs_alt: annotation score, not a direct model REF-vs-ALT call
candidate_statuses.blocker: Official GRCh38 annotation bundle is approximately 300 GB; license and asset checksum are not verified.

candidate_statuses.license: UCSC data-use terms; verify for redistribution
candidate_statuses.ref_vs_alt: not applicable without an unapproved comparator transform
candidate_statuses.blocker: No direct variant-effect score contract for the frozen raw-SNV comparison.

candidate_statuses.preprocessing: approved transcript/isoform missense subset with MSA features
candidate_statuses.raw_score_semantics: precomputed variant_pathogenicity for applicable missense variants
candidate_statuses.ref_vs_alt: precomputed applicability only; no current frozen missense subset
candidate_statuses.intermediate_layers: not applicable; weights are not published
candidate_statuses.fine_tuning: reference code only; not authorized or run
candidate_statuses.blocker: Current temporal cohort has no frozen transcript/missense applicability mapping.

cost_and_billing.interpretation: Workspace-level billing includes ephemeral app/image activity and volume accounting; it is not a per-request invoice. The smoke runner's H100 wall-rate estimates are not measured billed USD.

phase5_decision.reason: Two additional meaningful official tracks passed real checkpoint/embedding/logit smokes, but neither has a frozen compatible raw allele-effect contract. The model roster is now evidence-backed and no longer globally deferred merely because only Evo2 was verified.

resume_conditions: Resolve or formally approve the Phase 3 cohort discrepancy and provide the frozen GRCh38 FASTA/index.
Freeze a separate embedding/subset protocol if Nucleotide Transformer or Caduceus is to be used downstream.
Obtain a new approval for any full-cohort Phase 6, embedding extraction, training, or additional model assets.
Measure remote batch throughput before replacing the current low-confidence Phase 6 cost estimate.
